Downstream, displayed-citation universe collapsed to 0 and 100% of 78 claim units evaluated unsupported. Admission-recall failure dominates: fresh-holdout query phrasing (multi-part research asks, 46-85 CJK chars) embeds below the frozen whole-query admission floor and the existing deterministic sub-query recheck does not rescue them; no pre-marker gate measures this because corpus compatibility measures CORPUS binding, not QUERY-side admission recall.

V6 gold/rubric/threshold design performed as pre-registered (abstention and invalid-citation gates passed; scorer executed cleanly end-to-end).
